title: Finitely many finite separable extensions embed into one finite Galois extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, and let $L_1,\dots,L_n$ be field extensions of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension] which are finite ($\dim_kL_i<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there are a field extension $L/k$ and homomorphisms of $k$-algebras $\tau_i:L_i\to L$ ($i=1,\dots,n$) such that $L/k$ is finite ($\dim_kL<\infty$), separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and normal: for every $\beta\in L$ the minimal polynomial of $\beta$ over $k$ (as in [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]) is a product of polynomials of degree one in $L[T]$. (That is, $L/k$ is a finite Galois extension, Stacks, Fields, Definition 09I0, receiving every $L_i$.)

source.place: Fields, Lemma 09DT (fields-lemma-normal-closure, line 2086: existence of the normal closure of a finite extension) and Lemma 0EXM (fields-lemma-normal-closure-galois, line 2704: the normal closure of a finite separable extension is Galois); a finite separable extension containing copies of all L_i is obtained from Fields, Lemma 09GU (fields-lemma-map-into-algebraic-closure, line 1023: embed each L_i into an algebraic closure) and Lemma 09HC (fields-lemma-separable-elements, line 1435: the compositum of the images is separable). Used in the proof of More on Morphisms, Lemma 02LM (more-morphisms.tex lines 12064-12066: 'Choose a finite Galois extension L/kappa(s) such that there exist kappa(s)-embeddings L_i -> L')
